description: This Java source file defines the 'Commander' class, a command-line client component for sending commands to devices via Hono protocol adapters. It handles user input, manages command execution, and communicates with devices asynchronously using Vert.x.

classes.name: Commander
classes.description: Main class implementing a command-line client for sending commands to devices connected to Hono protocol adapters.

classes.name: Command
classes.description: Inner static class encapsulating a Hono command with its name, payload, content type, and one-way flag.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the Commander component, sets up connection handling, and starts command processing.

methods.name: startCommandClient
methods.description: Starts the command client upon successful connection.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes a command by sending it to the device, handling one-way or request-response modes.

methods.name: setRequestTimeOut
methods.description: Sets the request timeout for the command client.

methods.name: printResponse
methods.description: Prints the response received from the device.

methods.name: getCommandFromUser
methods.description: Prompts the user for command details and constructs a Command object.
